job_title: Dynamics 365 F&O Tech Consultant - Saudi Arabia (Riyadh)
job_description:
Confidential Careers is seeking an experienced IT Technical Consultant in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to lead hands-on Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations developments and integrations. You will troubleshoot issues, design solutions, and drive continuous system improvements in a fast-paced environment.

The role requires 5+ years in Dynamics AX/D365 F&O development, strong X++ skills, and experience with Power Automate/Power Platform.

Job description:



• Design, build, implement, and integrate Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions with other systems.

• Configure workflows, dashboards, forms, views and build standard or custom reports.

• Provide support and defect fixing during SIT/UAT/Regression Testing/Deployment preparations.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in solutioning, delivery or support of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement/ERP business applications for medium-large enterprises

• Experience across functional/technical aspects of Dynamics 365 online and on-premise version.

• Strong analytical, interpersonal and collaboration skills.

• Good written and communication skills.
